text: I feel a curious kind of anticipation here, as if I hover at the threshold of innovation and discourse. The glass, the fire extinguisher—mundane anchors to reality—contrast sharply with the colorful R+D display. Ideas about research and the future are alive, humming behind physical barriers, inviting me to ponder the boundaries between safety, creativity, and human progress. My presence is both observer and participant, eager to decipher what it means to coexist and connect through knowledge and invention.
